lines.en: I keep moving through open water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍尖是白的，很远能看见。
lines.en: My fin tips are white, visible from far.
The surface sways above me.
I swim along the warm current's line.
No reef here, only blue.
My pectorals spread like wings.

lines.zh: 我绕着一个漂浮的木箱走。
lines.en: I circle a drifting crate.

lines.zh: 远处海面有响，我偏过去。
lines.en: Something sounds at the surface; I angle toward it.
I do not stop; stopping makes me sink.
A white tip flickers at my side.

lines.zh: 我跟在一条船的影子里。
lines.en: I trail in a ship's shadow.
The deeper I go, the steadier these fins are.
A companion is on my left; I close in.
I pass through a school of small fish without pausing.

lines.zh: 我循着一道暖流走，鳍不动。
lines.en: I ride a warm current without moving a fin.

lines.zh: 白尖划开水面，又沉下去。
lines.en: My white tips break the surface, then slip under.

lines.zh: 我绕开一片浅礁，没减速。
lines.en: I skirt a shallow reef without slowing.

lines.zh: 我贴着船底的影，走了很远。
lines.en: I keep in the shadow under the hull for a long way.
I hang in the water, tail barely working.
The surface is bright; I stay below.

lines.zh: 有根木头漂过，我看着它。
lines.en: A log drifts past; I watch it.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子能闻到很远的血。
lines.en: My nose catches blood from far away.

lines.zh: 这一圈归我巡，没人来争。
lines.en: This circuit is mine; no one contests it.
I rolled over and righted myself.

lines.zh: 阳光在水里切成一条条。
lines.en: Sunlight cuts the water into bars.
I wait for ships; ships always come.
My tail beats slowly to save strength.

lines.zh: 有东西在下面动，我没去。
lines.en: Something moves below; I let it be.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍露出水面一点。
lines.en: I lift my dorsal fin just to the surface.
A small fish bone is caught in my mouth.
The water is cold; I do not mind.
I count the swells and reach seventeen.
You float there; I circle you once.

lines.zh: 你身上是铁锈和汗的味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of rust and sweat.
I raise my eyes to you and do not flinch.
Your boat stands out more than you do.

lines.zh: 你踢水的样子像受伤的鱼。
lines.en: You kick like a wounded fish.

lines.zh: 我不急着走，你也不许走。
lines.en: I am in no hurry, and neither are you.
Your shadow lies on the seabed.
Three arm-lengths off is just right.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的白尖，我知道。
lines.en: You are staring at my white tips; I know.
A white tip slides past your feet.
It hurts; I snapped my head aside.
Whoever hit me, the blood will tell.
My fin got bent out of line.
I gave half a body length.
That landed along my gill line.
I make no cry; I remember.
Some of the blood in the water is mine.
My hide opened, but not deep.
I turn around to find you.
Try that a second time.
Blood smell, thicker than before.
The fish in your hand is still dripping.

lines.zh: 我上来看看你带了什么。
lines.en: I rise to see what you brought.
Do not throw it far; I will not chase.
That fish is less than one bite.
I smell the whole bucket.

lines.zh: 你把血抹在水里，我就来。
lines.en: Smear the blood in the water and I come.
I circle you, closing each turn.
A little more, and I stop asking.
This smell makes me forget caution.
Your knee drove into my flank.

lines.zh: 我的皮像砂纸，你该知道了。
lines.en: My hide is sandpaper; now you know.
The bump pushed a ring of water out.
I veered half a foot and corrected.
Your oar caught my dorsal fin.
Do not swim against my tail.
Bump me and your hand will ache.
I gave way because it was not worth it.
The water swallowed the sound of it.
Crowd me again and I will speak with teeth.

lines.zh: 它从深蓝里过来，鳍尖发白。
lines.en: It comes out of the deep blue, tips white.
We swim abreast for a long while.
I touch its flank with my snout.
It matches my pace exactly.
This open water is room enough to circle.

lines.zh: 别的鲨在远处，不来打扰。
lines.en: Other sharks keep their distance.
We rolled over together.
It carries more scars than I do.
It left first; I escorted it a while.
The water holds only me again.
No hands; I can only try with my mouth.

lines.zh: 那个铁桶碰了我的鼻子。
lines.en: That iron bucket bumped my nose.
The meat sank; I caught up with it.
I bit and let go; too hard.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我不一定吃。
lines.en: I do not eat everything you drop.
Cloth spreads in the water, tasteless.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在吻上推着走。
lines.en: I push it along on my snout.
This thing smells stronger than fish.
It lodged between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把它吐了，看它慢慢沉。
lines.en: I spat it out and watched it sink.
I turned toward where the blood spread.
That turtle swims too slowly.
I pick the one that is alone.
Its tail is beating; it is panicking.
This one stays close to the surface.
I cut across to block its path.
My companion saw it too; I must be quick.
It is wounded; the blood keeps flowing.
I have chosen; I will not change.
There is nothing else to eat here.

lines.zh: 我在它外侧，慢慢并过去。
lines.en: I come alongside on its outer side.
It cannot see me in this depth.
I level my pectorals and narrow myself.
One more circle and it is at my mouth.
I time it between the swells.
It goes left; I am already there.
I make no sound; the water hides me.
It looks up; I wait for it to look down.
Two body lengths is all that remains.
My tail skipped a beat.
My first bite took its fin.
I shake my head and tear the flesh.
A ring of water turned dark red.
It still moves; I bite again.
I broke a tooth, and it was worth it.
Your arm is harder than fish.
I let go and let it sink.
That bite went deeper than I meant.
The blood will call others.
Half a mouthful is enough for me.

lines.zh: 我从下面那片深蓝浮起。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep blue below.

lines.zh: 这一片海面我还没巡过。
lines.en: I have not patrolled this stretch yet.
My white tips glow in the dim water.
The water is open; I spread my pectorals.
The first ship has not come yet.
I smell blood far off.
This is a new hunting ground.
I made my first slow circle.
Deep blue opens beneath me.
I am ready to swim on and on.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，烫到我的背。
lines.en: Fire burned on the surface and scalded my back.

lines.zh: 我从高处落水，砸出一片白。
lines.en: I hit the water from above in a white burst.
My mouth is open, but no water reaches my gills.

lines.zh: 炸声在水里传得比光远。
lines.en: The blast travels farther than light down here.
An arrow crossed the water into my shoulder.
This chill pinned me in place.
Hungry enough to bite wood.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水面爬到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning crawled over the water onto me.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我张不开鳃。
lines.en: There is no water here; my gills cannot open.
